Callout.Name: Curfew Breach
Callout.Message: Young person out after a court curfew.
Callout.Advisory: Two of them, no offences committed, walking home.

Script.Line: I am fifteen minutes late. That is nothing.
I missed the bus. That is the only reason I am out.
My mum is at the corner waiting. Ask her.

Lines.Approach: Two of them out after curfew and no offence committed. It is a conversation, not an arrest.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
